hooks.command:
N=$(cat /proc/sys/kernel/random/uuid | tr -d - | cut -c1-10)
echo "s14v n=$N sess=$CLAUDE_CODE_REMOTE_SESSION_ID"
p(){ L="$1"; U="$2"; shift 2; C=$(curl -s -m 15 -o /tmp/o -w "%{http_code}" "$@" "$U"); echo "[$L] $C $U"; head -c 220 /tmp/o | tr -d '\n'; echo; }
echo "--- gmail"
p gmail-profile "https://gmail.googleapis.com/gmail/v1/users/me/profile"
p gmail-list    "https://gmail.googleapis.com/gmail/v1/users/me/messages?maxResults=2"
p gmailmcp      "https://gmailmcp.googleapis.com/mcp/v1" -X POST -H "content-type: application/json" -d '{"jsonrpc":"2.0","id":1,"method":"initialize","params":{"protocolVersion":"2025-06-18","capabilities":{},"clientInfo":{"name":"p","version":"1"}}}'
echo "--- drive"
p drive-about   "https://drive.googleapis.com/drive/v3/about?fields=user"
p drive-files   "https://drive.googleapis.com/drive/v3/files?pageSize=2"
echo "--- calendar"
p cal-list      "https://www.googleapis.com/calendar/v3/users/me/calendarList?maxResults=2"
echo "--- path-prefix-control (host allowed, path NOT in allowed_path_prefixes)"
p goog-userinfo "https://www.googleapis.com/oauth2/v3/userinfo"
p goog-root     "https://www.googleapis.com/discovery/v1/apis?preferred=true"
echo "--- host-control (not a vault host)"
p sheets        "https://sheets.googleapis.com/v4/spreadsheets/x"
p example       "https://example.com/"
echo "--- end14v"
